generationConstraints.goal: Answer a pear-shaped shopper’s fit concern with visible sample evidence and a low-pressure sizing action.

comment.text: Does this skirt really not emphasize the hips on a pear-shaped body? The model photos don’t show it clearly.
comment.author: @FitQuestion
comment.note: Synthetic comment created for this portfolio demo.

merchantBrief.whyReply: This recurring fit question is blocking purchase decisions. The merchant wants to answer with front, side, and fabric evidence without making a universal fit claim.
responseFocus: Acknowledge that model photos do not answer every fit question
Show the high-rise A-line shape from the front
Show visible room through the hip area from the side
Show that the fabric holds its shape without looking stiff
Ask shoppers to check the size chart by waist before ordering
merchantBrief.targetAudience: Pear-shaped shoppers comparing skirt fits and worried that the silhouette may emphasize the hips
merchantBrief.tone: Direct, calm, evidence-led, and free of exaggerated slimming claims
mustAvoid: Do not claim that the skirt works for every pear-shaped body
Do not promise instant slimming or body transformation
Do not invent fabric composition, measurements, or model data
Do not generalize one sample fit to every shopper

product.name: High-Rise A-Line Denim Midi Skirt

facts.statement: The sample has a high-rise A-line shape; the front-view asset shows the skirt opening below the hips.

facts.statement: The side-view sample asset shows visible room through the hip area. This observation applies only to this sample and wearer.
The merchant describes the sample fabric as shape-holding without feeling stiff; the detail asset shows it forming a curve when pinched and falling naturally.
facts.source: Merchant fabric notes and fabric-detail asset

facts.statement: The merchant’s sizing guidance is to check the size chart by waist before ordering.

unknowns: No publishable fabric composition or weight is provided
The wearer’s measurements and sample size are not provided
The assets do not cover every waist-to-hip ratio
Static assets cannot prove fit during every movement or use case
